note: For each selected question, the eligible pages carrying evidence a governance consultant would put in front of a respondent before they score. null means nothing in these documents bears on the question — an abstention case, and what makes the similarity cutoff measurable at all. Relevance is judged at PAGE level rather than as verbatim phrases: a page is the same page under every chunking strategy, so one label set scores every configuration without favouring any chunk size, and a page is the unit the questionnaire actually cites. Excludes 05-previous-board-review, whose findings belong to the prior consultant and are never indexed. Drafted by Claude from the documents, then verified against a random blind sample by the author; the sampled agreement rate is reported in the README.
